title.zh: 【Telegram 内置 Gram 钱包更名为 Money，并向全体用户开放】
title.en: 【Telegram 内置 Gram 钱包更名为 Money，并向全体用户开放】

current_state.zh: Telegram's built-in Gram wallet has been rebranded as 'Money' and is now available to all of Telegram's 1B+ users, supporting Gram storage and transfers plus purchases of gifts and collectible usernames, with instant, network-fee-free transfers from Walt.
current_state.en: Telegram's built-in Gram wallet has been rebranded as 'Money' and is now available to all of Telegram's 1B+ users, supporting Gram storage and transfers plus purchases of gifts and collectible usernames, with instant, network-fee-free transfers from Walt.
